intro: IBPS PO has a prelims cutoff for the shortlist, a mains cutoff for the interview and a final cutoff on the combined score. The tables below use the UR category, and the figures are rounded as in the official notices.
factors: Sectional cutoffs. Clearing the overall figure is not enough if you fall short in any one of the three tests.
Number of vacancies and the number of candidates who appear in each shift.
Difficulty of the paper in each shift. IBPS normalises across shifts, so the overall figure moves with the paper.
Prelims marks do not count in the final merit, so do not over-invest in it after crossing the cutoff comfortably.
caveat: The 2026 prelims cutoff is already out and appears in the series. The mains and final cutoffs for the current cycle are not out yet.
target: For prelims, aim for about 5 to 8 marks over last year's UR cutoff to stay safe. For mains, aim well above the cutoff in the heavy sections, which are reasoning and data analysis.
